name: @openbucket/nestjs
description: Embeddable S3-compatible object store + admin console for NestJS applications.
//scarfSettings: Best-effort opt-out of @scarf/scarf install-time telemetry pulled transitively via @nestjs/swagger → swagger-ui-dist (TASK-2170). scarf-js honours an any-in-chain disable check, so a downstream `npm install @openbucket/nestjs` suppresses the beacon. Deterministic suppression for our own build/CI is via SCARF_ANALYTICS=false / DO_NOT_TRACK=1 in Docker/CI.
author: OpenBucket contributors

comments.persistence: The persistence entities + repositories are bundled into this package at src/lib/persistence (formerly the @openbucket/persistence workspace lib). There is no separate package to publish.
comments.build: `nx build nestjs` compiles clean (the persistence fold-in removed the lib->lib TS6059 error). For a publishable artifact build the frontend first (Node 23: `nx build openbucket-frontend`), then `nx bundle-spa nestjs` (Node 20) runs the lib tsc build and copies the SPA into assets/spa. Publish from dist/libs/nestjs.
